Our story

Comprehensive Care Across Life Stages

South Denver OB/GYN & Midwives serves women from adolescence through menopause with eight highly experienced physicians, six Certified Nurse-Midwives, and four Nurse Practitioners across Littleton and Castle Rock locations. We provide hospital birth at Littleton and Castle Rock Adventist Hospitals, full-scope midwifery care, and surgical procedures for gynecological issues. Our practice takes a holistic and personal approach to encourage better quality of life.

Accepting New Patients

Ask about this offer →
Good to know

Questions, answered.

Don't see yours? Call (303) 738-1100 — a real person answers.

What services do your midwives provide?

Our Certified Nurse-Midwives offer full-scope midwifery care including pregnancy and hospital birth at Littleton and Castle Rock Adventist Hospitals, well-woman annual physicals, gynecology from puberty to menopause, family planning and contraception (including IUDs and Nexplanon), preconception counseling, infertility consults, sexual dysfunction, breastfeeding support, and STI screening.

Do you accept insurance?

Yes. We bill in-network insurance and you are responsible for copay, coinsurance, and deductible at time of service. We do not bill out-of-network insurance. We recommend verifying your coverage in advance by contacting your insurance company. If we cannot verify your insurance before your visit, you will be required to pay in full at time of service.

What payment options do you offer?

We accept cash, check, debit/credit card (MasterCard, VISA, American Express, Discover), FSA, and HSA accounts. For patients with difficulty paying balances of $300 or less, we offer a standard payment plan: $100 down and $50 per month. For larger balances, contact our billing manager to discuss options.

Do you offer self-pay options?

Yes. Self-pay patients—those without insurance, out-of-network patients who choose not to bill, or insured patients who elect not to file claims—receive transparent and affordable pricing. You must notify office staff of your self-pay status before your visit. Government-sponsored plan holders (Medicare, Medicaid, Tricare) are not eligible for self-pay.

What happens if I need to cancel my appointment?

We ask for at least 24 hours notice when canceling. Appointments canceled under 24 hours or missed without notice incur a $50 fee starting with the second occurrence. After three occurrences, your account will be reviewed for dismissal from the practice.

How do I become a patient?

Contact your insurance company to notify them of your new primary care provider and request the change to one of our physicians associated with OnPoint Medical Group (Tax ID 36-4778373). Request your medical records from your current provider and have them sent to South Denver OB/GYN & Midwives. Call us at 303-738-1100 or email OMGSDOGInfo@AdventHealth.com to register and schedule your appointment.
